flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No hitlist and no add/remove screen. Only the daily send to CES exists, driven by a suspension query: ocmsadminprivateapi schedulers/CesUploadJobsScheduler, services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.findCertisForeignVehicleNotices. ocmsadminui: Tagged Vehicle route/menu commented out (App.tsx:326-329; LinkData.tsx:406)
note: Status blank (epic ERP2, 'Logic/flow not received'). There is no hitlist as data and no API or screen to add/remove vehicles. The daily list to CES (same as OCMS33.1) is rebuilt every day from the PS/FOR notice query (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:313-322), so a manual change to a 'hitlist' has no entry point. Indirectly, an officer applying or lifting PS/FOR through the general suspension feature changes the query result the next day, but that is not an add/remove hitlist feature and is not claimed. The send to CES stays Sebagian here because the list sent is not a reviewed hitlist (consistent with OCMS33.1, which judges the send path itself). Ticket OCMS-SR-2026-150 (CES job, not finished) does not change the verdict.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. There is no hitlist or add/remove screen; the daily list to CES is only a suspension query result. Only the daily send path can be claimed (see OCMS33.1)

steps.step: The Tagging officer adds a vehicle to the hitlist at any time
steps.detail: There is no hitlist screen, endpoint or table. The tagged-vehicle route is commented out (App.tsx:326-329) and the menu is commented out (LinkData.tsx:406); grep hit.?list returns nothing in the six repos.

steps.step: The Tagging officer removes a vehicle from the hitlist at any time
steps.detail: Same as the previous step: no remove-from-hitlist function. The only indirect route is lifting the PS/FOR suspension through the general suspension feature so the notice drops out of the query (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:313-322); that is not a hitlist removal and is not counted.

steps.step: The updated daily list is sent to the frontend enforcement system
steps.detail: The daily CES job at 00:05 builds the file from the suspension query (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/schedulers/CesUploadJobsScheduler.java:43-52, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:313-322) and sends it encrypted via SFTP (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl.java:104-116, ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/comcrypt/helper/ComcryptCallbackHelper.java:256-258), so a daily list is sent. But its content is not a hitlist edited by the officer; it only follows notice suspension status. The real server property values and receipt at CES cannot verify from repo.
